rules.name: rrr-dcs-acm-iol-probe-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT s.security_id, s.derivative_type, s.underlying1_id, s.underlying2_id, s.strike1, s.maturity_date, sv.value_date, sv.settle_price, sv.created_by, sv.created_timestamp FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND sv.business_unit = s.business_unit AND sv.security_id = s.security_id AND sv.value_date BETWEEN :from AND :to WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.contract_number = 'DCS_WP_003' ORDER BY sv.value_date

SELECT s.security_id, sv.value_date, sv.settle_price, sv.created_by, sv.created_timestamp FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND sv.business_unit = s.business_unit AND sv.security_id = s.security_id AND sv.value_date BETWEEN :from AND :to WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.contract_number = 'DCS_WP_003' ORDER BY sv.value_date

SELECT contract_number, value_date, derivative_type, active_lots, settle_price, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, is_premium_paid, premium_paid_usd, mkt_value_usd, mtm_usd, maturity_date FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(contract_number, '_', 1) = 'DCS'

SELECT 'current' AS source, COUNT(*) AS cs_spread_securities, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.security_id IS NULL) AS no_price_row, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.settle_price = 0) AS zero_price FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND sv.business_unit = s.business_unit AND sv.security_id = s.security_id AND sv.value_date = :valueDate WHERE s.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND s.business_unit = :bu AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'cs_spread%' AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :valueDate) UNION ALL SELECT 'migration copy', COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.security_id IS NULL), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.settle_price = 0) FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND sv.business_unit = s.business_unit AND sv.security_id = s.security_id AND sv.value_date = :valueDate WHERE s.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND s.business_unit = :bu AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'cs_spread%' AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :valueDate)

SELECT upper(split_part(contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client_code, contract_number, trade_id, active_lots, CAST(mtm_usd AS numeric(30, 10)) AS mtm_usd, CAST(mtm_nc AS numeric(30, 10)) AS mtm_nc FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate AND derivative_type = 'avg_swap_cc' AND upper(split_part(contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('ACM', 'IOL') ORDER BY 1, 2
